topic: Template Class Specialization and Usage in C++
explanation: In C++, templates enable generic programming by allowing classes and functions to operate with generic types. Template classes can be specialized to provide custom implementations for specific types, enhancing flexibility and efficiency. This feature is fundamental for creating reusable, type-safe components such as containers, iterators, and synchronization primitives in the Standard Template Library (STL). Specialization allows developers to optimize or modify behavior for particular types without altering the general template definition.
